description: This Java class 'EntityArtifactInfo' models metadata about an entity in the Apache OFBiz framework, including its relations, associated services, ECA rules, forms, and screens.

classes.name: EntityArtifactInfo
classes.description: Represents metadata and relationships of an entity within the OFBiz framework, including related entities, services, ECA rules, forms, and screens.

methods.name: EntityArtifactInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the EntityArtifactInfo with the specified entity name.

methods.name: populateAll
methods.description: Populates related entities based on one-to-one and many-to-many relations.

methods.name: getModelEntity
methods.description: Returns the ModelEntity object representing the entity.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name, which is the unique ID of the entity.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type identifier for entity info.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier, the entity name.

methods.name: getLocationURL
methods.description: Resolves and returns the URL location of the entity.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on entity name.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on toString() output.

methods.name: getEntitiesRelatedOne
methods.description: Returns set of related entities with one-to-one relations.

methods.name: getEntitiesRelatedMany
methods.description: Returns set of related entities with many-to-many relations.

methods.name: getServicesUsingEntity
methods.description: Retrieves services that use this entity.

methods.name: getServicesCalledByEntityEca
methods.description: Placeholder for retrieving services called by entity ECA rules.

methods.name: getEntityEcaRules
methods.description: Placeholder for retrieving ECA rules associated with the entity.

methods.name: getFormsUsingEntity
methods.description: Retrieves forms that use this entity.

methods.name: getScreensUsingEntity
methods.description: Retrieves screens that use this entity.
